_comment: Skill list shipped with TierMux — the offline fallback, exactly like media/mcp-registry.json. A skill is a prompt that runs with the agent's permissions, so `firstParty` asserts one checkable fact and nothing more: the repo it installs from belongs to the vendor of the thing it teaches (anthropics/skills is Anthropic's org, vercel-labs/agent-skills is Vercel's). It is NOT a review of the content. Everything else is listed with its real repo so it can be read before installing. The live list comes from tiermux.skillRegistryUrl (default: the catalog worker's /skills), so this file only has to be right when that is unreachable.
